test_bisect_explicit_hypothesis: test the bisect_trajectory function with an explicit hypothesis to chop off the tail of actions
test_bisect_implicit_hypothesis: test the bisect_trajectory function using env.validate as the implicit hypothesis for bisection
test_reverse_bisect: test the bisect_trajectory function in reverse mode to chop off the prefix of actions
test_minimize_trajectory_iteratively: test the minimize_trajectory_iteratively function to reduce a trajectory to the minimal set of actions
test_random_minimization: test the random_minimization function to stochastically reduce a trajectory while preserving a hypothesis
